custodyProfile.uncertainty: Immediate assets sit in vault and adapter/market contracts; the curator terms deny custody and fiduciary obligations. Ultimate parent reserve custody, borrower-collateral custody, legal priority, continuity resources and legal reuse rights are not fully established for this exact share. Whole-book custody is mixed: lender claims are dominated by USDe (66.7%) and Maple syrupUSDG (25.3%) collateral whose reserves sit with off-chain custodians and credit managers, beside onchain contract positions; safeguards of those layers remain unestablished. Lending deployment is intentional strategy reuse; it does not establish custodians' contractual rights to repledge collateral, which remain unknown.
